She witnessed the return of the Herald of Death, her homeland lacerated in the maw of the beast. She uncovered the root of the curse, trembling as she accepted the truth of her family's tragedy. But this was an entirely unprecedented apocalypse. It made her face the possibility of losing her companions, {NICKNAME} most of all. She couldn't understand why the fate of the cosmos had to rest on {M#his}{F#her} shoulders. All she knew was that {M#he}{F#she} was now family, forever. So, once again, she chose to carry it all alone, just as she always used to say: "Traveling always has an end point. When it happens, I'll smile and say goodbye to everyone." Amidst the mockery of the world falling into utter silence, the Starblazer reached its limit, and the Express crashed once more. Before the farewell, she embraced {NICKNAME} and made a wish to the Stellaron to guard the Trailblaze. The stars grew hazy in a crimson mist, and she became as weak as she once was. "It's been so long. You've grown up... and become even more remarkable than I ever was." For a fleeting moment, she thought she could feel the girl's warmth again as if she were still there, watching over her in silence. "I think I've finally gotten a little closer to you." She couldn't help but pour out everything that had happened since they parted: The paths walked by the legendary Navigators, now trodden by her own feet; the wonders she had once only dreamed of, witnessed with her own eyes; the companions she had found, those kindred spirits, people she could truly trust... "Just as you once traded your destiny for mine, I would trade my destiny for my companions'..." "But look, your companions aren't about to let you go anywhere." {NICKNAME}'s wish moved her to tears. The unyielding defiance of the Nameless set her blood ablaze once more. "Where your journey ends, mine begins anew..." Two warm hands withdrew gently from her back, and the girl smiled with quiet tenderness, their silhouette slowly merging with each other. "If there's nothing ahead of us..." She became one with the ideal she had always strived toward, as her companions reached out their hands and cried out together, "Then we'll Trailblaze a path forward with our own hands!"
